hooks.command: echo '[ai-maestro-maintainer-agent] Guardian Mode active. The patrol skill auto-baselines if the snapshot is missing; to refresh manually, invoke maintainer-guardian in baseline mode. The skill is idempotent — re-running just refreshes the baseline at $AGENT_DIR/.aimaestro/state/guardian-baseline.json. Baseline covers T1-T6 threat detection (T1 workflow scanners, T2 stale SHA pins, T3 branch-rule drift, T4 protected-path activity, T5 secret-leak markers, T6 package-manager safety-config drift). The maintainer is the guardian of the repo, not a reactive issue-fixer. A resume is a wake: drain the AMP inbox FIRST (amp-inbox, then amp-read per message) and act on any mandate before other work — a mandate is a work order, not a banner. See the AMP discipline bullet in the persona for the commands and the degrade rules. FROZEN CLI ONLY (IRON RULE): every ai-maestro interaction goes through the frozen scripts (amp-*, aimaestro-*.sh, aid-*) — NEVER the server /api/* directly, not even as a fallback when a script is missing; degrade explicitly instead. Stated here because a hook runs with NO skill loaded, so no skill can instruct it. (gh and package-registry APIs are not covered — keep them.)'
